teaching.title: Introductory Programming Teaching Assistant
bullets: Assisted introductory programming lab sessions covering lists, arrays, and loops, and answered student questions during office hours.
Prepared worked examples on lists, arrays, and loops for review by the supervising course instructor.

projects.title: Flashcard Practice Interface

Tested keyboard interaction and alternate input cases for the flashcard practice interface as part of the team project.

projects.title: Date Parser Testing

projects.title: Document Lookup Data Structures
